query:
SELECT id,name,entity_type,website,photo_url,updated_by,
 CASE WHEN profile ? 'website' THEN profile->'website' ELSE NULL END AS raw_website,
 profile ? 'website' AS raw_website_present,
 profile#>>'{_meta,updated_by}' AS profile_writer,
 profile->>'hero_url' AS raw_hero,profile ? 'hero_url' AS raw_hero_present,profile->>'photo_url' AS raw_photo,profile ? 'photo_url' AS raw_photo_present,
 profile->'_enrich'->>'source_url' AS source_url,profile->'_enrich'->>'source_kind' AS source_kind,
 profile->'_enrich'->>'checked_at' AS checked_at,profile->'_enrich'->>'source_fingerprint' AS source_fingerprint,
 profile->'_enrich'->>'hero_url' AS machine_hero,profile->'_enrich'->>'photo_url' AS machine_photo,profile->'_enrich'->>'logo_url' AS machine_logo,
 profile->'_enrich'->'photo_urls' AS machine_gallery,
 profile->'_enrich'->'organization_identity_quarantine' AS organization_identity_quarantine,
 profile->'_enrich'->'scope_review_required' AS scope_review_required,
 profile->'_enrich'->>'identity_scope' AS identity_scope,
 profile->'_enrich'->>'blocked_reason' AS blocked_reason
 FROM zoi.listings WHERE publish_status='published' AND moderation_status IN ('clean','cleared') AND coalesce(marketplace_status,'')<>'hidden'
 AND (coalesce(profile#>>'{_enrich,hero_url}','')<>'' OR coalesce(profile#>>'{_enrich,photo_url}','')<>'' OR coalesce(profile#>>'{_enrich,logo_url}','')<>'' OR (jsonb_typeof(profile#>'{_enrich,photo_urls}')='array' AND profile#>'{_enrich,photo_urls}'<>'[]'))
 AND coalesce(profile#>>'{_enrich,source_url}','')<>''
 AND (regexp_replace(lower(substring(website FROM '(?i)^https?://([^/?#]+)')),'^www[.]','') IS DISTINCT FROM regexp_replace(lower(substring(profile#>>'{_enrich,source_url}' FROM '(?i)^https?://([^/?#]+)')),'^www[.]','')
 OR (coalesce(nullif(substring(website FROM '(?i)^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'),''),'/')<>'/' AND regexp_replace(coalesce(nullif(substring(website FROM '(?i)^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'),''),'/'),'/$','') IS DISTINCT FROM regexp_replace(coalesce(nullif(substring(profile#>>'{_enrich,source_url}' FROM '(?i)^https?://[^/?#]+([^?#]*)'),''),'/'),'/$',''))
 OR profile ? 'website')
 ORDER BY entity_type,name,id;
